channels.docs:
**list**: A list of channels to configure.

*See also: [USB Host UART Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_uart#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: An id to assign to the channel. This id may be used anywhere a `uart` component is required.

*See also: [USB Host UART Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_uart#configuration-variables)*

pid.docs:
**int**: The product ID of the device. Use 0 as a wildcard. Each type has a default PID which will be overridden if this is set.

*See also: [USB Host UART Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_uart#configuration-variables)*

vid.docs:

*See also: [USB Host UART Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_uart#configuration-variables)*

CONFIG_SCHEMA.docs: The type of USB-serial device to connect to. One of `ft23xx`, `ch34x`, `ch340`, `esp_jtag`, `stm32_vcp`, `cdc_acm`, `cp210x`, `pl2303`, `pl2303gc`, `pl2303gb`, `pl2303gt`, `pl2303gl`, `pl2303ge`, `pl2303gs`.
